newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank scraps weekly note auction.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank scraps weekly note auction.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Thursday it had scrapped the scheduled auction of two billion baht of 28-day notes on Friday due to changing market liquidity.

The central bank did not clarify its decision but market sources said money market liquidity remained tight this week with the overnight interbank rate hovering at 20-22 percent and the overnight interfinance rate averaging 25-30 percent on Thursday. The interfinance rate refers to loans from commercial banks to finance companies. -- Bangkok newsroom (662)-6520642
